A '''polarizing field insulator suit''' was a heavy suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was usually worn by [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] who faced a risk of exposure to powerful energy discharges. It had a powerful generator that created an insulation field around the wearer. It mainly protected the wearer against electrical and ion energy, but didn't protect against other forms of attack.
